parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under both `Examples/` and `WallpaperSampleApp/` — the canonical sample-app path patterns identified in the decision rules. Even though the `is_sample_app` flag is recorded as `false`, the file path unambiguously places this implementation inside a sample application. The production copy in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` (package `DebugPanel`) is the authoritative implementation; the `DebugHUD.swift` copy is a local convenience for the sample app's debug overlay. Merging or extracting these would couple the production `DebugPanel` package to sample-app semantics, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against.
